title: Data Validation Results
description: Expected column layout for user-provided validation results. Input format: Excel (.xlsx) with a single 'Validation Results' sheet containing one row per check. This schema defines a single result row; the Excel sheet contains an array of such rows (columns A through M). Strict schema: only aggregated counts and check metadata — no row-level data, no business keys, no PII.

check_id.description: Column A: Unique check identifier matching the validation plan check_id (e.g., 'ER-01', 'SCD2-03')

check_name.description: Column B: Human-readable check name from the validation plan description

status.description: Column C: Execution status — 'executed' (ran to completion), 'error' (query failed), 'skipped' (check not applicable or deliberately omitted)

source_count.description: Column D: Row count from the source query (exact reconciliation checks)

target_count.description: Column E: Row count from the target query (exact reconciliation checks)

mismatch_count.description: Column F: Number of rows where source and target values differ (column-level reconciliation)

violation_count.description: Column G: Number of rows violating a null check, datatype check, or business rule

overlap_count.description: Column H: Number of SCD2 records with overlapping effective date ranges for the same key

gap_count.description: Column I: Number of SCD2 keys with gaps in their effective date timeline

broken_boundary_count.description: Column J: Number of SCD2 records where boundary convention is violated (e.g., eff_end_dt < eff_start_dt)

invalid_current_record_count.description: Column K: Number of SCD2 keys with zero or multiple current (open) records

affected_key_count.description: Column L: Number of distinct primary key values affected by the check finding

error_message.description: Column M: Error message when status is 'error'; null when status is 'executed' or 'skipped'
